title: IEEE Xplore Digital Library
short_description: IEEE Xplore provides full-text discovery and access to more than 6 million research papers, peer-reviewed journals, transactions, conference proceedings, technical standards, and educational courses.

title: IEEE Membership Portal (Join & Renew)
short_description: Official IEEE portal for creating membership accounts, joining IEEE as a professional or student member, selecting technical societies, and renewing annual memberships.

title: IEEE Student Branch Finder
short_description: Official geographic search tool to locate IEEE Student Branches, Student Branch Chapters, and Affinity Groups across universities and colleges in all 10 IEEE regions worldwide.

title: IEEE Students Official Portal
short_description: The central hub for all IEEE student members, offering resources on forming a student branch, branch officer tools, leadership training, student contests, and graduation transitions.

title: IEEEXtreme Programming Competition
short_description: IEEEXtreme is a global 24-hour virtual competitive programming challenge where teams of IEEE student members compete against thousands of teams worldwide under proctor supervision.

title: IEEE Student Scholarships, Grants & Fellowships
short_description: Comprehensive portal for IEEE student awards, including the Richard E. Merwin Student Scholarship, Charles LeGeyt Fortescue Graduate Scholarship, and conference travel grants.

title: IEEE Student Branch Virtual Resource Center (VRC)
short_description: Resource kit for IEEE Student Branch officers, containing constitution templates, branch reporting guidelines, funding opportunities, and marketing collateral.

title: IEEE Women in Engineering (WIE)
short_description: Global network of IEEE members dedicated to promoting women engineers and scientists, inspiring girls around the world to follow academic interests in STEM fields.

title: IEEE Young Professionals (YP)
short_description: International community dedicated to helping young professionals and recent graduates transition smoothly from academia into successful engineering careers.

title: IEEE SIGHT (Special Interest Group on Humanitarian Technology)
short_description: Global network of IEEE volunteers partnering with underserved local communities to leverage technology for sustainable development and humanitarian relief.

title: IEEE Standards Association (IEEE-SA)
short_description: The globally recognized standards-setting body of IEEE, responsible for establishing market-driven technical standards such as IEEE 802.11 (Wi-Fi) and IEEE 802.3 (Ethernet).

title: IEEE Computer Society
short_description: The premier professional organization for computer scientists and software engineers, publisher of Computer magazine and IEEE TPAMI, and organizer of flagship conferences.

title: IEEE Communications Society (ComSoc)
short_description: World-leading community for professionals in communications and networking, publishing IEEE JSAC and IEEE Communications Magazine, and hosting IEEE GLOBECOM and ICC.

title: IEEE Power & Energy Society (PES)
short_description: Leading global society for electric power, smart grids, renewable energy, and power systems engineering, publishing IEEE Transactions on Power Systems.

title: IEEE Robotics and Automation Society (RAS)
short_description: The global hub for robotics, autonomous vehicles, and industrial automation research, organizer of ICRA and IROS conferences and publisher of IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO).

title: IEEE Signal Processing Society (SPS)
short_description: IEEE's oldest technical society, specializing in the theory and application of filtering, coding, transmitting, estimating, and detecting signals (audio, video, speech, image).

title: IEEE Computational Intelligence Society (CIS)
short_description: Premier society focusing on neural networks, fuzzy systems, evolutionary computation, and machine learning, publisher of IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (TNNLS).

title: IEEE Electron Devices Society (EDS)
short_description: Society advancing the development of electronic, photonic, and semiconductor devices, including microelectronics, quantum electronics, and transistors (IEDM conference sponsor).

title: IEEE Solid-State Circuits Society (SSCS)
short_description: Dedicated to integrated circuits (IC) design, sponsoring the prestigious International Solid-State Circuits Conference (ISSCC) and publishing the IEEE Journal of Solid-State Circuits (JSSC).

title: IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBS)
short_description: The world's largest international society of biomedical engineers, developing healthcare technology, medical devices, neuroengineering, and bioinformatics.

title: IEEE Photonics Society
short_description: Dedicated to the science and technology of generating, controlling, and detecting photons, spanning lasers, optical communications, biophotonics, and quantum optics.

title: IEEE Aerospace and Electronic Systems Society (AESS)
short_description: Focuses on radar, avionics, space systems, navigation, and defense electronics across air, sea, land, and space environments.

title: IEEE Microwave Theory and Technology Society (MTT-S)
short_description: Dedicated to RF, microwave, millimeter-wave, and terahertz technologies, sponsoring the annual International Microwave Symposium (IMS).

title: IEEE Author Center
short_description: Official authoring portal with guidelines, LaTeX and Word manuscript templates, submission portals, and peer-review policies for publishing papers in IEEE journals and conferences.

title: IEEE Access (Open Access Journal)
short_description: Multidisciplinary, peer-reviewed, open-access journal published by IEEE covering all technical domains with rapid, high-quality peer review.

title: IEEE Spectrum Magazine
short_description: The flagship magazine of IEEE, delivering in-depth reporting, analysis, and breaking news on global technology trends, engineering innovations, and science breakthroughs.

title: IEEE DataPort
short_description: Recognized global research data repository enabling researchers and data scientists to store, share, access, and cite datasets up to 2TB per dataset with persistent DOIs.

title: IEEE Learning Network (ILN)
short_description: Premier online learning platform providing continuing education courses, professional development hours (PDHs), and CEUs across AI, 5G, cybersecurity, and power engineering.

title: IEEE Job Site & Career Center
short_description: Global career portal connecting engineering professionals and students with technology employers, technical internships, and engineering vacancies worldwide.

title: IEEE ResumeLab
short_description: An exclusive career-building tool for IEEE members offering professional resume builders, portfolio templates, and mock interview practice.

title: IEEE TryEngineering (STEM Portal)
short_description: IEEE's pre-university education initiative providing STEM lesson plans, engineering games, university degree program searches, and summer camp directories for students and educators.

title: IEEE Foundation
short_description: The philanthropic partner of IEEE, funding humanitarian projects, educational programs, and technological history initiatives that benefit communities around the world.

title: IEEE History Center (ETHW)
short_description: The Engineering and Technology History Wiki (ETHW), preserved by the IEEE History Center, recording milestones, oral histories, and archives of engineering breakthroughs.

title: IEEE vTools Portal
short_description: Official IEEE organizational and management platform used by Student Branches, Sections, Subsections, and Chapters to record meetings, officer elections, activity reports, and event registrations.

title: IEEE Collabratec
short_description: Integrated online community and collaboration platform that connects global technology and engineering professionals for networking, authoring, and sharing research.

title: IEEE Conferences Search Portal
short_description: Comprehensive searchable directory of over 1,900 international IEEE conferences, call for papers (CFP), submission deadlines, and conference proceedings.

title: IEEE Technical Societies Directory
short_description: Official directory of the 39 specialized IEEE technical societies and councils spanning computer science, robotics, power systems, communications, and electronics.

title: IEEE-USA (United States Activities)
short_description: Organizational unit of IEEE that supports the career, public policy, and professional interests of IEEE members in the United States across Regions 1 through 6.

title: IEEE Canada (Region 7)
short_description: Official organizational entity representing IEEE Region 7 (Canada), encompassing 20+ sections, 60+ student branches (such as U of T, UBC, McGill, Waterloo), conferences, and awards.

title: IEEE Region 8 (Europe, Middle East, Africa)
short_description: IEEE Region 8 covers Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, organizing student and professional activities, IEEE MELECON, and EUROCON conferences across 50+ sections.

title: IEEE Region 10 (Asia-Pacific)
short_description: IEEE Region 10 (R10) covers the Asia-Pacific area, spanning India, China, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and Southeast Asia, serving hundreds of thousands of members and student branches.

title: IEEE India Council
short_description: Coordinating body of all 13 IEEE Sections in India (including Bangalore, Bombay, Delhi, Hyderabad, Madras, Kerala, etc.), organizing INDICON and fostering student branch networks.

title: IEEE Bangalore Section
short_description: One of the premier and most active IEEE Sections in Region 10 (Asia-Pacific), founded in 1976. Oversees Student Branches, Subsections (Mysore, Mangalore, North Karnataka), and technical society chapters across Karnataka.

title: IEEE Mysore Subsection
short_description: Subsection established under the IEEE Bangalore Section to support engineering colleges, research centers, and active student branches like NISB across the Mysore region.

title: NISB - NIE IEEE Student Branch Official Portal
short_description: Official portal of the NIE IEEE Student Branch (NISB) at The National Institute of Engineering, Mysuru, Karnataka, India. Established in 1999 under the IEEE Bangalore Section and IEEE Mysore Subsection, organizing Adroit, Ankura, WIE events, and technical workshops.
